summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile UI testing of ZedPulse pharmacy direct-contact + user-submission + in-app admin dashboard feature. All 25 new backend pytest cases pass (100% success) covering: public /pharmacy/stockists shape (9 seeded, phone/whatsapp/note/name/status=approved, no auth), POST /pharmacy/submit auth-gated with correct validation (short name 400, missing contact 400, happy-path returns pending), GET /pharmacy/submissions/mine returns only own submissions (and strips submitted_by/submitter_phone from response), admin login includes role=admin, signup defaults role=user, /auth/me includes role, non-admin JWT => 403 on all admin endpoints, admin GET /admin/stats returns {users, pharmacies, pending_submissions, glucose_readings, bp_readings}, admin can list pending, approve creates approved pharmacy (visible in public /pharmacy/stockists), reject marks rejected, admin CRUD pharmacies (add/list/update/delete) + delete 404, add validates short name. Regression suite covers / , /clinics, /pharmacy/items (34 items), glucose/bp/reminders/medications CRUD, share-link, report — all pass. Mobile UI (390x844) verified end-to-end: admin login succeeds and 'Admin dashboard' row shows ONLY for admin in Settings; non-admin cannot see entry and direct /admin shows 'Access denied. Admin only.'; Pharmacy watch footer renders 7 Call + 7 WhatsApp buttons for the 7 seeded pharmacies with contact numbers and 'Suggest a pharmacy or branch' button navigates to /pharmacy-submit; submit form posts a submission and 'My submissions' list reflects it immediately with status pill. React Native deprecation detected: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` console warning observed on login screen (likely from a dependency, not blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Fires on auth/login render. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx and any custom components using pointerEvents as prop.

action_items: Minor: Replace any `pointerEvents="..."` prop usage with `style={{ pointerEvents: "..." }}` to silence the React Native Web deprecation warning (search frontend/ for `pointerEvents=`).

Minor UX nit (optional): The admin tab testID is `admin-tab-submissions` while the visible label is 'Pending'. Consider aligning (rename testID to `admin-tab-pending`) for less test friction — product works fine either way.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~1418 lines — consider splitting (auth, readings, pharmacy, admin, llm) into separate routers/modules for maintainability.
`@app.on_event('startup')` is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager in a future refactor.
/api/admin/submissions endpoint accepts arbitrary `status` string query without an allowed-values check — acceptable since admin-only, but a Literal['pending','approved','rejected'] would be safer.
Pharmacy admin add endpoint always sets status='approved' with no override — fine for current UX; document in API if admin ever needs to create pending entries.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup hook auto-seeds admin user +260000000000/9999 and 9 default pharmacies. No additional seeding needed. Tests create and clean up TEST_-prefixed submissions/pharmacies within the admin CRUD suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin + pharmacy submission flow is production-ready and fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_11_pharmacy_admin.py (also /app/backend/tests/test_09_pharmacy.py). Admin creds: +260000000000 / 9999 (auto-seeded on backend startup). Regular test user: +15550001234 / 1234 (or signup fresh). Admin screen uses testID `admin-tab-submissions` (not `admin-tab-pending`) for the Pending tab. Pharmacy watch 'Where to buy' footer renders Call button for entries with phone and WhatsApp button for entries with whatsapp OR phone (frontend falls back to phone via wa.me). Government clinics entry intentionally has 3-char phone '991' (short code).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All asserted business logic paths behave per the specification. Minor React Native Web `pointerEvents` deprecation warning stems from upstream React Native internals or a library using the legacy prop; main agent can grep frontend code for `pointerEvents=` to migrate to style.
